records.subject: Confirming cancellation for Timber Studio
records.body:
Hi Felix,

This confirms the cancellation of your Wrenfield plan. Sorry to see Timber Studio go -- if there's feedback on what didn't work, I'd genuinely like to hear it.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Still want to get Timber Studio set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Sometimes the hardest part is just the first project. If you'd like, send me a rough list of what your team's working on and I'll help set it up myself.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: keeping an eye on Timber Studio this week

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Timber Studio
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Timber Studio* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no tickets, and no customer reply to two emails [email:e6bcd8d7, email:938f7ac1] despite a held welcome call [calendar:19a83100]. Silence plus zero product steps after a call suggests low unaided odds in the remaining 8 days, though the call shows some intent.

draft.subject: Getting Timber Studio's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Great to talk last week. Since then I wanted to follow up on the first step we touched on: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project up is usually what makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
